notes.title: ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER - Episode 1: The Void Mirror Prototype Out Today!
notes.content:
[b]Episode 1: The Void Mirror Prototype[/b] is now available for [b]ONE PIECE World Seeker[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34555689/a0241a2497eccced6a13912209bce6f115d861a2.png[/img]

[b]Zoro[/b] will be working with Tashigi to find out the secret of Isaac’s experimental weapon. The two enemies will have to cooperate to save the Island.
Zoro will also be fighting the admirals Kizaru and Fujitora on the Island, two of the greatest foes he ever had to face!

Watch the trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m_bX0l9dbIw
Get the [b]Episode Pass[/b] now to unlock Zoro and the upcoming DLC Episodes 2 and 3!

notes.title: ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER - Patch 1.03
notes.content:
A new patch, including free updates, will be available on July 11th for ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER.
­­
Patch Ver. 1.03 contents:
[list]
[*] Added Treasure Hunting Outfit (from One Piece Stampede)
[*] Added new Challenge Mission (available after clearing the full game)
[*] Increased difficulty of Tashigi, Fujitora, Kizaru, which will be applied after clearing the full game
[*] Added new equipment
[*] Improved game balance
[/list]

Thank you for your support, we hope you continue to enjoy playing ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER!

notes.title: ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER - DLC Episode 1 The Void Mirror Prototype
notes.content:
We’re pleased to finally reveal that players will be able to play as other characters in ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER – starting with Roronoa Zoro in the first DLC: Episode 1: The Void Mirror Prototype.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34555689/5d925dd49a01f50b705612866e18629a3742428b.jpg[/img]Available to download in early summer 2019,  this standalone expansion brings 4 hours of new story, and will focus on Zoro’s side adventure in a brand new location. The story takes place parallel to Luffy’s main plot – and provides players with the opportunity to slash, slice and sever with Zoro’s unique sword-fighting style! 
Watch the trailer:
https://youtu.be/FRiB7yMPSbM

notes.title: ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER Launch Trailer Released
notes.content:
We’ve today released the launch trailer of ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER, setting the scene for players ahead of the game’s release on Friday 15th March 2019 for PlayStation®4, Xbox One and PC.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34555689/8921dd9e90b4806e5f0b3a335821a379d596bef3.jpg[/img]
ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER will take players through an exclusive ONE PIECE story, which was written under supervision by original author Echiro Oda. Finding themselves on Prison Island, a once prosperous place devastated by military rule, the Straw Hat Crew set out to tackle the tyrannical warden, Isaac, and discover the island’s real purpose.

European Version:
https://youtu.be/K68pZ2kLE8s
US version:
https://youtu.be/CHkuke3Vp90

notes.title: One Piece World Seeker introduction trailer - Welcome to Prison Island.
